info.bio:
Pylon was an American post-punk band formed in Athens, Georgia in 1978. For most of the band's career, they consisted of Vanessa Briscoe Hay (vocals), Randall Bewley (guitar), Michael Lachowski (bass) and Curtis Crowe (drums). The group released three albums, "Gyrate" (1980), "Chomp" (1983) and "Chain" (1990).

All four members of Pylon were art students at the University of Georgia in Athens. Guitarist Randall Bewley and bass guitarist Michael Lachowski began playing music and attempting to form a band in 1978.

scenes.name: B-52's y la escena de Athens
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: Frente al sadismo de la no wave, una banda que quería que el público bailara: ropa de los cincuenta, pelucas batidas, dos mujeres de voces poderosas (Kate Pierson, Cindy Wilson) y la voz nasal de Fred Schneider, un «camp sublime» de películas clase B, cómics y kitsch de tienda de segunda mano. Bajo la apariencia, un baile agresivo entre James Brown y Gang of Four: Entertainment! fue la banda sonora de las fiestas de Athens, ciudad universitaria como Leeds. «Rock Lobster» (1978) triunfa a ambos lados del Atlántico. Su familia incluye a Pylon («suena como si les corriera dub por las venas») y al joven Michael Stipe.

podcast.title: Athens, Georgia Music Scene
podcast.body: Pylon is listed as one of the more obscure groups that were part of the Athens, Georgia music scene which began in the mid-1970s. "The Athens, Georgia music scene, began in the mid 1970s with the B-52s and more obscure groups like the fans and pylon and the tone tones and love tractor and method actors."
